Phase cohorts do not distinguish TPACK from TAACK; whole-run opcode counts are exported separately.
No-balancing has no weight transfers or critical weight source.
VOQ residence and allocator service sums are resource workload, not additive layer latency.
Class1 is TPACK plus weight TAACK; token TAACK belongs to class2.
Bounded raw rings are intentionally overwritten; no packet-chain completeness claim or raw export is made.
